spanish: Y vino Dios a Bilam de noche, y le dijo: Si para llamar a ti vinieron los hombres, levántate, anda con ellos; y solo la palabra que yo hable a ti, ella harás.

findings.issue: Piel imperfect 1cs (I will speak) is smoothed as present subjunctive hable in the relative clause; the speaking force stays the same.

notes: Remaining tokens match: Dios, Bilam, night, call-you, the men came, rise, go with them, only the word, object suffix, you shall do.
